AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Represents an administrative user for the RotaKula application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the admin user.

email.description: Email address of the admin user.

firstName.description: First name of the admin user.

lastName.description: Last name of the admin user.

Survey.title: Survey
Survey.description: Represents a survey response from a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the survey response.

poiId.description: The ID of the Point of Interest the survey is for.

poiName.description: The name of the Point of Interest.

guidance.description: Whether the user received guidance service.

staffing.description: Whether a staff member attended to the user.

cleanliness.description: Rating for the cleanliness of the area (1-5).

transportation.description: Rating for the ease of transportation (1-5).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the survey was submitted.

Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Represents a feedback submission from a user about the application.

name.description: Name of the user providing feedback (optional).

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the feedback was submitted.

surveys.description: Collection to store user survey responses.

feedback.description: Collection to store user feedback about the application.
